answer: My answer to sybils is Anonymous blacklist check via private set intersection — a check against a ban list without revealing identity — which makes the summit of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own a check against a ban list without revealing identity, and the basalt grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the ember of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
